releasePolicy: The THC Living Plant Atlas production release requires all six photorealistic specimen states. No single generic cannabis model may stand in for sex phenotype or growth-stage differences.

requiredSpecimens.label: Seedling
requiredTraits: cotyledons or clearly juvenile first growth
early true leaves with developmentally appropriate leaflet complexity
short juvenile stem and compact node spacing
small developing root system appropriate to seedling scale
no mature floral structures

requiredSpecimens.label: Vegetative
requiredTraits: established branching architecture
mature fan leaves with realistic cannabis serration and venation
clear nodes and internodes
developed stem and root architecture
no mature flower clusters

requiredSpecimens.label: Flowering
requiredTraits: mature flowering whole-plant silhouette
realistic inflorescence distribution
bract and sugar-leaf integration
visible pistil and resin/trichome character where appropriate
full exposed root system

requiredSpecimens.label: Male
requiredTraits: staminate reproductive structures
believable pollen-sac clustering and attachment
male plant architecture without fake female bud masses
clear node-level reproductive morphology
no impossible mixed-sex structures unless explicitly teaching intersex expression

requiredSpecimens.label: Female
requiredTraits: pistillate reproductive structures
bracts and stigmas where developmentally appropriate
female floral architecture distinct from the male specimen
sugar leaves and resin-bearing floral surfaces where mature
no unexplained staminate clusters

requiredSpecimens.label: Hermaphrodite / Intersex
requiredTraits: clearly identifiable male and female reproductive expression on the same specimen
mixed structures placed at botanically plausible nodes or floral sites
female bract/stigma morphology remains recognizable
staminate or anther expression remains recognizable
no ambiguous AI deformation presented as intersex biology
